text: I think sport is important because it keeps our body and mind healthy. When people exercise, they have more energy and they get ill less often. Also, sport can help to reduce stress, which is a big problem for many people today. For example, after a hard day at work, a short run can make you feel better. In addition, team sports help people to make friends and to learn to work together.

tips.en: One sentence holds the position and the reason.
tips.kk: Бір сөйлемде ұстаным мен себеп бар.
tips.ru: Одно предложение содержит позицию и причину.
tips.example: I think sport is important because it keeps our body and mind healthy

tips.kk: In addition тағы бір дәлел қосады.
tips.ru: In addition добавляет ещё один аргумент.
tips.example: In addition, team sports help people to make friends

questions.followUp: Do you think everyone should do sport?
questions.question: Why is it important for people to do sport?

text: I think the main reason is that people are busy. They work or study all day and in the evening they feel too tired. Another reason is that many people spend a lot of time on their phones or in front of the TV. Some people also think that sport is expensive, because gyms can cost a lot of money. However, you can exercise for free, for example by walking in the park.

tips.en: Another reason helps you list causes.
tips.example: Another reason is that many people spend a lot of time on their phones
However, you can exercise for free

questions.question: Why do some people not do enough exercise?

text: I think it's a good idea, but not necessarily every day. Children have a lot of energy, and sport helps them to concentrate better in other lessons. However, some children don't like competition, so schools should offer different activities, such as dancing or swimming. In my opinion, the most important thing is that sport should be fun. If children enjoy it, they will continue to be active when they grow up.

tips.en: Not necessarily makes the opinion more precise.
tips.ru: Not necessarily делает мнение более точным.

tips.en: If + will shows a likely result.
tips.example: If children enjoy it, they will continue to be active when they grow up

questions.followUp: What sports are popular among children in your country?
questions.question: Do you think children should do sport at school every day?

text: In some cases, yes. Famous football players, for example, earn millions of euros every year, while doctors or teachers get much less. On the other hand, a sports career is short and risky, because players can get injured. Also, sport brings a lot of money to clubs from TV and advertising. So I understand why they earn a lot, but I think society should also respect other important jobs more.

tips.en: On the other hand balances the view.
tips.kk: On the other hand пікірді теңгереді.
tips.ru: On the other hand уравновешивает мнение.
tips.example: On the other hand, a sports career is short and risky
So I understand why they earn a lot
